errors.what: MS label slips: '7(c)(Ii)' (capital I), '1(v)(i)'-(iii) printed for 1(a)(vi), 'pH 4 circled' printed with no label (= 2(d)) merged into 2(c)
errors.fix: ms.label_text lowercases roman numerals (chem); run.py: ONE part without rows takes the stray-labelled rows whose marks match, or the merged row is split at its printed rule; ms_layout: such a row shows the paper's label in its Q cell, _tighten keeps the outer border for a marked row

errors.what: atom letters printed as tall tiny images (6 x 42 pt) missing from MS structure pictures: redaction removed every image reaching outside the cut; an image's centre below the row kept the end atoms out
errors.fix: render: chemistry redaction blanks only the pixels outside (PDF_REDACT_IMAGE_PIXELS); store._chem_structures: letter images sized by their ink, accepted up to 60 pt tall

errors.what: a text line under a structure half inside the picture: 'nvoneerepeatunit(1)', '1 anyonerepeatunitwithexte', 'propan-2-ol' cut
errors.fix: _chem_structures: a word line the picture only partly covers stays text (picture stops above / starts below it)

errors.what: the H under a carbon cut by a figure crop's bottom edge (2022 MJ 21-23 q35; 2021 ON q11 bottom H atoms) - bond line starting at the edge
errors.fix: fit_crop (chemistry): vertical bond ITEMS at the top/bottom edge followed to their end + the atom letter there (the drawing's rect missed the lower line)

errors.what: papers before 2023 print no 'Fig.' captions: ZERO figures in every theory/practical paper of 2005 MJ, 2015 MJ, 2021-2022 (approved C0 + 2022 ON included) - diagrams were loose lines + text in the print layout (rotated labels broken), missing from the editable layer
errors.fix: extract: chemistry papers with no caption anywhere use the maths uncaptioned-diagram finder; mark lines '[2]' / '[Total: n]' trimmed off; region_svg respaces words for chemistry ('leastreactive')
